title: In Indonesia, PhD students blow the whistle on bad supervision
title_zh: 在印度尼西亚，博士生揭露不良的指导行为
abstract: The nation plans to boost the number of doctoral candidates, but some early-career researchers warn of systemic challenges, including poor-quality supervision.
abstract_zh: 该国计划增加博士候选人数量，但一些早期研究人员警告存在系统性挑战，包括指导质量低下。
snippet: The nation plans to boost the number of doctoral candidates, but some early-career researchers warn of systemic challenges, including poor-quality supervision.
